With Effect Statues, you only need to craft a potion once—then turn it into a statue! Right-click the statue anytime for reusable effects. Convenient and powerful!

- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: They Are Watching You
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Creepy eyes, twisted shadows, and ghostly glimmering bodies: the “They Are Watching You” skin pack features terrifying monsters that always seem to stare into your soul. See-through and totally spooky, these skins are perfect for haunting servers and creeping out your friends.

Play… if you dare.

items.title: Purple x Black
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: Step into the shadows with a splash of power! The Purple x Black skin pack brings mysterious, magical vibes with every skin. Perfect for players who love bold style and dark energy. From epic battles to secret builds, you’ll look fierce, fresh, and unforgettable. Rule the world in purple and black!

items.title: Mystical Agriculture
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Mystical Agriculture! The massively popular Java mod, now as an Add-on!

Grow resources with crops! This Add-on adds 40+ new crops for materials & mobs.

- Craft upgradable tools & armor.
- Automate farming.
- Boost growth & process resources.
- Enchant items.
- Infusion crafting.
- Collect and use mob souls.
items.changelog:
New in 1.2.3
Added End Agglomeratio, farmland from dirt, and more seed recipes. Improved Inferium yields, piston behavior, and recipes. Fixed watering cans, tool issues, book entries, and block entity bugs.

items.title: CAVES: Fire & Ice
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
CAVES: FIRE & ICE makes the underground the best part of your world... vast, dangerous & alive.
- Explore endless caves, randomly generated with INFINITE variations
- Fight new bosses & mobs, or tame loyal companions
- Mine new ores; forge armor, weapons & tools
- VFX & Dynamic Lights
Transforms any world, new or existing. YOUR WORLD will never be the same!
items.changelog: THE OVERHAUL UPDATE: We rebuilt CAVES from the depths up. Remastered visuals, lighting & VFX across every biome, plus re-engineered caves that run smooth with far less lag. Everything you loved is preserved, fully compatible with your existing worlds. Same adventure, brand-new experience.

items.title: Cityscapes London

items.description:
Explore the vibrant streets of London in this immersive city, featuring historic districts, cozy alleyways, and iconic landmarks. Wander past centuries-old buildings, modern skyscrapers, and hidden corners that capture the blend of old and new.
